_readme: Everything on zoisports.com/robrun. Edit, bump `updated`, then run: node tools/build-robrun.mjs. Only put things here the game does not already show (no price lists). Labels: official = Kefir; data = game files via fan wikis; player = player reports; zoi = our advice.

xpjDecoder.name: XP Journal: decoders and base raids

rggMoney.name: ROB RUN GG Wiki: money making

kefirLooty.name: Kefir: First look at Looty Bay (mirror)

wikiRaid.name: ROB RUN Wiki: base defence and raiding

plan.do: Lockpick, Backpack, Light Armor, Action Camera
plan.why: Cheap kit for solo store runs. Keep the junk you loot: it packs into collection crates later.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title I: rent a level 1 plot next to a Reservoir
plan.why: Pick a hex next to a Reservoir: each harvest gets a 50% chance of extra bags. Your base, own car and laundering all need a plot.
plan.label: player

plan.why: Bushes can't be bought. Plant every one you find; they regrow after each harvest.
plan.label: player

plan.why: Add one each time you have 6 more bushes. Best payback in the game.
plan.label: player

plan.why: Bushes grow 12% faster. Do this before anything that isn't the Grow Room.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Packs a few cheap stolen items into a $50k crate. Sets are worth far more than the same items sold to the Fence.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Repack $10k crates into $35k ones. Players net $10k to $20k a crate.
plan.label: player

plan.why: 6 cargo slots, 12 with racks. Every other early car has 1.
plan.label: data

plan.why: The Workshop fits 4 benches. A Small House adds only 1 more, for $800k.
plan.label: player

plan.why: 7 more sets for the Collection Table.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title II: move to a level 2 plot
plan.why: Opens the Mini Drill, Water Pump, Special Collection and Titan.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Another 14% off grow time. It's the main reason to go level 2.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Mini Drill, Code Tablet, USB Hacking Tool
plan.why: Opens the big safes and starts the bank job chain.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Almost twice the Van's speed, same 6 cargo slots. Sells back for $360k.
plan.label: data

plan.do: Land Plot Title III: move to a level 3 plot
plan.why: Only with 20+ hours of play left. Otherwise stop at step 16 and bank the rest. Opens UV Lamps and the Unique Collection.
plan.label: data

plan.why: Bushes grow 24% faster. With all three upgrades a table grows twice as fast.
plan.label: data

tips.text: Sell harvest bags alone at a Fence for the +35% sale bonus: $40k became $54k, and $250k became about $325k. Sell in small batches so one robbery can't take it all.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Keep every bench loaded. Reload them every 30 minutes.
tips.label: zoi

tips.text: Buy Contraband Cargo from your settlement's seller. Residents get a discount.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Sell cargo in one trip with your crew. Police can seize it on the road.
tips.label: data

tips.text: Never leave cash or cargo at the base or in the trunk.
tips.label: player

tips.text: If you're close to the next Notoriety level, wait to sell big cargo. Level 5 pays 25% more than level 1.
tips.label: data

lastDay.text: Don't start long builds or research. They won't pay back before the raid.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Last grow cycle: harvest, then sell each bush to the Smuggler. A bush is worth $20k or more.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Sell all cargo. Every $500,000 you hold at the wipe is one more year of jail time, up to 40 years.
lastDay.label: data

lastDay.text: Banked cash is wiped too, but it still counts toward jail time.
lastDay.label: official

lastDay.text: Agree with your crew on which realm you all join next.
lastDay.label: data

bestRuns.lead: Cash per hour, ranked. All of these are player reports, one player's or squad's result, not a promise.

ranked.name: Full Grow Room
ranked.note: 6 tables, 36 bushes. Grows while you rob or are offline, and a death doesn't stop it. One table of 6 bushes is ~$34k / hour.

ranked.name: Store runs
ranked.note: One solo player made $600k in 3 hours.

ranked.name: Cop shift
ranked.note: Best report: $100k in 45 min. A normal shift is closer to $30k. You keep your own gear.

ranked.name: Contraband bench
ranked.note: $10k to $20k net per 30-minute crate. Passive, so stack it with everything above.

perJob.name: Bank heist
perJob.note: Squad job. Needs a Drill, an ID Card and a Mini Drill, and the drill alerts the whole city.

perJob.name: ATM restock event
perJob.note: How often it happens isn't known.

tips.text: Pick stores by safes per minute, not size. A jewelry store with two safes beats a hotel with five cabinets.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Sell at your district's hub when you can. Kefir says it can pay well above Looty Bay.
tips.label: official

tips.text: Plant bushes instead of selling them. A planted bush keeps paying every harvest. Late in the week, sell it.
tips.label: player

tips.text: Leave at about $100k in the bag. Smaller cash-outs lose less when a squad shows up.
tips.label: player

bestRuns.unknown: Nobody has published reliable per-minute numbers for specific crates or routes, how often a repack comes out as Rarity Cargo, or what the Nov 4 patch did to production payouts.

duo.lead: Two players, one base. One builds, one runs.

items.text: Base: does all the research and buying, so nothing is paid for twice. Harvests every cycle, reloads the benches and launders.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Runner: store runs, every growing bush (gun shops and gear stores first), collection items, and crates in the Van.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Harvest bags: one of you sells them alone at a Fence, in small batches, for the solo sale bonus. The other stays away or guards from a distance.
items.label: player

items.text: Driver: stays in the car, engine ready, hands empty. Drawing a weapon drops cargo you're carrying.
items.label: player

items.text: Guard: does the store. Break the alarm box and shoot the cameras first, and skip the glass.
items.label: player

items.text: Loot and sell in separate trips, so you rarely lose both.
items.label: player

items.text: Before selling, check the Fence or Smuggler as a Civilian first. Campers wait there.
items.label: player

items.text: It warns both of you the moment a hack starts.
items.label: data

items.text: Whoever is closer goes home. The other one finishes the sale or banks, so the run isn't lost too.
items.label: zoi

items.text: You have time: each decoder takes about 12 seconds at the panel, so a fused building takes minutes.
items.label: player

items.text: After a hack, repair the panel on the spot. Your fuses survive and the defense comes back.
items.label: player

items.text: Both of you launder after every sale. Banked money can't be stolen by players.
items.label: official

items.text: Use your own Laundering Desk; Lenny takes a share.
items.label: player

items.text: Withdraw only what the next buy needs. Cash on you can be taken.
items.label: zoi

raids.lead: Nothing protects an offline base except fuses and alarms. Here's how raiders get in and what to do about it.

items.text: They hack the gate panel from outside, then a building's Security System with decoders until its defense hits zero. Then that building opens for a while.
items.label: player

items.text: One hack opens one building, not the whole base.
items.label: player

items.text: They go for the weakest money buildings first: the Grow Room and Chemical Laboratory have some of the lowest base defense.
items.label: player

items.text: Decoders don't open safes or cage racks. That takes a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: An open door lets anyone who jumps the fence walk straight in.
items.label: player

items.text: Eviction Rights were pulled from barter on Nov 17, for now.
items.label: official

items.text: Best: nowhere. Sell it and bank the cash.
items.label: zoi

items.text: If it has to wait, put it in a cage rack or safe, so a raider also needs a Master Key.
items.label: data

items.text: Spread cash, loot and cargo over several buildings. Each one needs its own decoders, so raiders run out.
items.label: player

items.text: Not in the car. A trunk can reportedly be opened anywhere.
items.label: player

items.text: Fuse the Grow Room first, then the Workshop. They hold your income, and the Grow Room opens easily.
items.label: zoi

items.text: Fill slots with Fuse I first. It's the cheapest per point; move to bigger fuses when slots run out.
items.label: data

items.text: Put your Clan Alarm on the building that holds the most value. A panel has 3 alarm slots.
items.label: player

items.text: Alarms add no defense. They only warn you.
items.label: data

items.text: Close every door before you log off.
items.label: player

paysNote: Pays back is in hours you're online. The short end is math from game prices, the long end is from player reports.

cars.text: Longhorn Van first, Titan later. Both carry 6 crates; the Titan is much faster.
cars.label: data

cars.text: Skip the Royal E and J, the Longhorn Wild and the Buletti. They cost $1M to $10M and carry 0 to 4 crates.
cars.label: data

rentOwn.text: Level 2 and 3: rent. Owning a level 2 settlement costs about $1.55M more. At the 5% laundering tax you'd have to launder about $31M to win that back.
rentOwn.label: data

rentOwn.text: Level 3: rent. Owning costs $8M and won't pay back within one wipe.
rentOwn.label: data

rentOwn.text: Level 1: own if a free settlement is close in the first 3 days. It's $300k vs $150k. You skip the 5% tax and collect it from tenants, so it pays back in about 3 days if you launder $1M a day.
rentOwn.label: data

rentOwn.text: On a brand-new server you may have to own: you can only rent where someone already owns the settlement.
rentOwn.label: data

growCore.text: The Grow Room is the core of this plan. Fill all 6 tables and put a Fan, Water Pump and UV Lamp on each as soon as your plot level allows. One player reports over $500k from about 40 minutes of harvesting with upgraded tables.
growCore.label: player

plotSpace.text: Fill the Grow Room's 6 tables first. If your plot only fits two buildings, take a Grow Room and a Workshop, not two Grow Rooms: bushes can't be bought, so a second room may sit empty.
plotSpace.label: zoi
